151 of the 800 questions are not counted for this model. Its provider ends the response stream without returning an answer when the model reasons for a very long time, which it does on the hardest items even at low effort (40k+ reasoning tokens), so the losses fall on the hardest questions and cluster in four domains: chess puzzles (54), string rules (29), reasoning puzzles (28) and code trace (27). Its score is therefore measured on an easier subset than every other model's and should be read as an optimistic estimate.
